output.reason: The changelog line [ev-93cfde7716c1] is vague by itself, but the linked PR [ev-76ea83ca1d29] makes it concrete. It is a new feature that adds results caching for instant metric queries and optional subquery split alignment. It adds three config keys: `cache_instant_metric_results` (Boolean, disabled by default), `instant_metric_results_cache` (cache config) and `instant_metric_query_split_align` (Boolean). [ev-ca949405f95b] explains how instant queries are split into subqueries, and [ev-f56e9f0d5fd7] shows the new instant_metric_cache.go and the config/docs changes. So applicability is environments that enable these keys. The consequence is informational: caching is off by default, so nothing changes unless the operator opts in. One gap: the excerpt is cut off before the default of `instant_metric_query_split_align` is stated, although the PR describes it as support "to enable" alignment.
